page.title: Super Admins
page.description: Grant platform-level access. New admins verify their email before their account is created.

table.selfStatusTooltip: You can't change your own status
table.selfDeleteTooltip: You can't delete your own account

createDialog.title: New super admin
createDialog.description: We'll email a 6-digit code to verify their email before the account is created.

form.passwordHint: Must be at least 8 characters, with 1 uppercase letter, 1 special character, and a mix of lowercase letters and numbers.

otp.title: Verify email
otp.description: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
otp.label: Verification code
otp.otpSendFailed: Account created, but the verification email failed to send — check SES config

editDialog.title: Edit super admin
editDialog.description: Update this super admin's name and email.
editDialog.emailHint: Changing this re-issues their login — a new temporary password is emailed to the new address.

deleteDialog.title: Delete super admin
deleteDialog.description: Permanently remove "{{name}}" as a super admin? This cannot be undone.
